<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

for n in green_items:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    positions.append((r, c))

positions.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
print(f"Positions: {positions}")

blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
if blue_items:

    blue_c = sum(p[1] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
    print(f"Blue at: ({blue_r}, {blue_c})")

# Click purple to reset/activate
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 8, 'col': 15}])
print(f"After purple click: state={last_action_result.get('state')}")

# Move character to far right
for _ in range(10):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
if blue_items:

    print(f"Blue col: {blue_c}")

# Collect items far from character (left side first)

green_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
positions = []

    boundary = n['boundary']

    c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    positions.append((r, c))

# Sort by column, click leftmost first (farthest from character at right)
positions.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print(f"Positions sorted by col: {positions}")

collected = 0
for r, c in positions:
    if c <= 39:  # Far from character at ~50
        result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
        state = last_action_result.get('state')
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
        print(f"Clicked ({r}, {c}): green={green_count}, state={state}")
        collected += 1

        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
            print("Level completed!")
            break
        if green_count > len(positions):
            print("REGENERATION!")
            break

print(f"Collected {collected} items")
